# Redis Solution Pvt. Ltd.

> Redis Solution is a full-service digital agency based in Rawalpindi, Pakistan. We design, build, and scale AI-powered digital products — from custom AI agents and LLM integrations to full-stack web applications, mobile apps, ERP systems, and digital marketing campaigns.

## About Us

Redis Solution was founded in 2020 with one belief: Pakistan deserves a software company that doesn't cut corners. Today we serve startups, enterprises, and international businesses with cutting-edge technology solutions.

- **Founded:** 2020
- **Location:** 2nd Floor, Rawalpindi, Pakistan
- **Team:** 15+ professionals
- **Clients:** 100+ businesses worldwide
- **Retention:** 98% client satisfaction

## Services

- [AI Agents & Integrations](https://redissolution.com/services#ai-applications): Custom AI agents (Claude, OpenAI), RAG pipelines, n8n automation, MCP servers
- [Web Development](https://redissolution.com/services#web-development): Full-stack web applications, SaaS platforms, Laravel, React, Vue.js
- [Mobile App Development](https://redissolution.com/services#mobile-apps): Cross-platform Flutter apps with native performance
- [Digital Marketing](https://redissolution.com/services#digital-marketing): SEO, Google Ads, Meta campaigns, social media strategy
- [Software Development](https://redissolution.com/services#software-development): Custom enterprise software solutions
- [ERP & CMS Development](https://redissolution.com/services#erp-cms): Custom ERP systems and content management platforms
